author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand sits down with Candace Owens to explore growing concerns around how media narratives are shaped—and reshaped—over time. From shifting headlines to evolving interpretations of past and present events, the conversation looks at how information can be framed in ways that influence public perception. It also raises the idea that, despite the noise, people can often sense when something doesn’t fully align.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand reflects on his journey from the highs of Hollywood to a deeper search for meaning—opening up about faith, truth, and what it means to live beyond a surface-level lifestyle. After years immersed in fame, success, and the pressures of the entertainment world, he describes coming to a realization that something was missing. That search ultimately led him toward Christianity, where he found a sense of clarity, purpose, and freedom that he hadn’t experienced before.
